targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    metric_value AS value
FROM monitoring.sqlserver_metrics
WHERE metric_name = 'user_sessions'
  AND database_name IS NULL
ORDER BY collected_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    metric_value AS value
FROM monitoring.sqlserver_metrics
WHERE metric_name = 'running_requests'
  AND database_name IS NULL
ORDER BY collected_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    metric_value AS value
FROM monitoring.sqlserver_metrics
WHERE metric_name = 'blocked_requests'
  AND database_name IS NULL
ORDER BY collected_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    metric_value AS value
FROM monitoring.sqlserver_metrics
WHERE metric_name = 'sqlserver_memory_mb'
  AND database_name IS NULL
ORDER BY collected_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    metric_value AS value
FROM monitoring.sqlserver_metrics
WHERE metric_name = 'available_os_memory_mb'
  AND database_name IS NULL
ORDER BY collected_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    $__timeGroupAlias(collected_at, '5m'),

    AVG(metric_value) FILTER (
        WHERE metric_name = 'user_sessions'
    ) AS "نشست‌های کاربری",

    AVG(metric_value) FILTER (
        WHERE metric_name = 'running_requests'
    ) AS "درخواست‌های در حال اجرا",

    AVG(metric_value) FILTER (
        WHERE metric_name = 'blocked_requests'
    ) AS "درخواست‌های مسدودشده"

FROM monitoring.sqlserver_metrics

WHERE database_name IS NULL
  AND metric_name IN (
      'user_sessions',
      'running_requests',
      'blocked_requests'
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(collected_at)

GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT
    $__timeGroupAlias(collected_at, '5m'),

    AVG(metric_value) FILTER (
        WHERE metric_name = 'sqlserver_memory_mb'
    ) AS "حافظه مصرفی SQL Server",

    AVG(metric_value) FILTER (
        WHERE metric_name = 'available_os_memory_mb'
    ) AS "حافظه در دسترس سیستم"

FROM monitoring.sqlserver_metrics

WHERE database_name IS NULL
  AND metric_name IN (
      'sqlserver_memory_mb',
      'available_os_memory_mb'
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(collected_at)

GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    metric_value AS value
FROM monitoring.sqlserver_metrics
WHERE metric_name = 'database_online'
  AND database_name = '$database'
ORDER BY collected_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    metric_value AS value
FROM monitoring.sqlserver_metrics
WHERE metric_name = 'data_size_mb'
  AND database_name = '$database'
ORDER BY collected_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    metric_value AS value
FROM monitoring.sqlserver_metrics
WHERE metric_name = 'log_size_mb'
  AND database_name = '$database'
ORDER BY collected_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    metric_value AS value
FROM monitoring.sqlserver_metrics
WHERE metric_name = 'user_connections'
  AND database_name = '$database'
ORDER BY collected_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    metric_value AS value
FROM monitoring.sqlserver_metrics
WHERE metric_name = 'avg_write_latency_ms'
  AND database_name = '$database'
ORDER BY collected_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    metric_value AS value
FROM monitoring.sqlserver_metrics
WHERE metric_name = 'avg_read_latency_ms'
  AND database_name = '$database'
ORDER BY collected_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH io_data AS (
    SELECT
        collected_at,
        metric_name,
        metric_value,
        LAG(metric_value) OVER (
            PARTITION BY metric_name
            ORDER BY collected_at
        ) AS previous_value
    FROM monitoring.sqlserver_metrics
    WHERE database_name = '$database'
      AND metric_name IN ('reads_total', 'writes_total')
      AND $__timeFilter(collected_at)
),

io_delta AS (
    SELECT
        collected_at,
        metric_name,
        GREATEST(metric_value - previous_value, 0) AS delta_value
    FROM io_data
    WHERE previous_value IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT
    collected_at AS "time",

    MAX(delta_value) FILTER (
        WHERE metric_name = 'reads_total'
    ) AS "عملیات خواندن",

    MAX(delta_value) FILTER (
        WHERE metric_name = 'writes_total'
    ) AS "عملیات نوشتن"

FROM io_delta
GROUP BY collected_at
ORDER BY collected_at;

SELECT
    collected_at AS "time",

    MAX(metric_value) FILTER (
        WHERE metric_name = 'avg_read_latency_ms'
    ) AS "تأخیر خواندن",

    MAX(metric_value) FILTER (
        WHERE metric_name = 'avg_write_latency_ms'
    ) AS "تأخیر نوشتن"

FROM monitoring.sqlserver_metrics

WHERE database_name = '$database'
  AND metric_name IN (
      'avg_read_latency_ms',
      'avg_write_latency_ms'
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(collected_at)

GROUP BY collected_at
ORDER BY collected_at;

WITH io_volume AS (
    SELECT
        collected_at,
        metric_name,
        metric_value,
        LAG(metric_value) OVER (
            PARTITION BY metric_name
            ORDER BY collected_at
        ) AS previous_value
    FROM monitoring.sqlserver_metrics
    WHERE database_name = '$database'
      AND metric_name IN (
          'read_mb_total',
          'write_mb_total'
      )
      AND $__timeFilter(collected_at)
),

io_delta AS (
    SELECT
        collected_at,
        metric_name,
        GREATEST(
            metric_value - previous_value,
            0
        ) AS delta_mb
    FROM io_volume
    WHERE previous_value IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT
    collected_at AS "time",

    MAX(delta_mb) FILTER (
        WHERE metric_name = 'read_mb_total'
    ) AS "حجم خوانده‌شده",

    MAX(delta_mb) FILTER (
        WHERE metric_name = 'write_mb_total'
    ) AS "حجم نوشته‌شده"

FROM io_delta
GROUP BY collected_at
ORDER BY collected_at;

WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(collected_at) AS collected_at
    FROM monitoring.sqlserver_index_fragmentation
    WHERE database_name = '$database'
)

SELECT
    schema_name AS "اسکیما",
    table_name AS "جدول",
    index_name AS "ایندکس",
    ROUND(avg_fragmentation_percent::numeric, 2) AS "درصد پراکندگی",
    page_count AS "تعداد صفحات"
FROM monitoring.sqlserver_index_fragmentation
WHERE database_name = '$database'
  AND collected_at = (
      SELECT collected_at
      FROM latest_snapshot
  )
  AND index_id > 0
  AND page_count >= 100
ORDER BY avg_fragmentation_percent DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(collected_at) AS collected_at
    FROM monitoring.sqlserver_index_usage
    WHERE database_name = '$database'
)

SELECT
    schema_name AS "اسکیما",
    table_name AS "جدول",
    index_name AS "ایندکس",
    user_seeks AS "Seek",
    user_scans AS "Scan",
    user_lookups AS "Lookup",
    user_updates AS "Update",
    (
        user_seeks +
        user_scans +
        user_lookups
    ) AS "کل خواندن"
FROM monitoring.sqlserver_index_usage
WHERE database_name = '$database'
  AND collected_at = (
      SELECT collected_at
      FROM latest_snapshot
  )
  AND index_id > 0
  AND (
      user_seeks +
      user_scans +
      user_lookups
  ) > 0
ORDER BY "کل خواندن" DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(collected_at) AS collected_at
    FROM monitoring.sqlserver_index_usage
    WHERE database_name = '$database'
)

SELECT
    schema_name AS "اسکیما",
    table_name AS "جدول",
    index_name AS "ایندکس",
    user_seeks AS "Seek",
    user_scans AS "Scan",
    user_lookups AS "Lookup",
    user_updates AS "Update",
    last_user_seek AS "آخرین Seek",
    last_user_scan AS "آخرین Scan"
FROM monitoring.sqlserver_index_usage
WHERE database_name = '$database'
  AND collected_at = (
      SELECT collected_at
      FROM latest_snapshot
  )
  AND index_id > 0
  AND (
      user_seeks +
      user_scans +
      user_lookups
  ) = 0
ORDER BY
    user_updates DESC,
    table_name,
    index_name
LIMIT 20;

WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(collected_at) AS collected_at
    FROM monitoring.sqlserver_missing_indexes
    WHERE database_name = '$database'
)

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS value
FROM monitoring.sqlserver_missing_indexes
WHERE database_name = '$database'
  AND collected_at = (
      SELECT collected_at
      FROM latest_snapshot
  );

WITH ordered_waits AS (
    SELECT
        wait_type,
        collected_at,
        wait_time_ms,

        LAG(wait_time_ms) OVER (
            PARTITION BY wait_type
            ORDER BY collected_at
        ) AS previous_wait_ms

    FROM monitoring.sqlserver_wait_stats

    WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at)
),

deltas AS (
    SELECT
        wait_type,
        GREATEST(
            wait_time_ms - previous_wait_ms,
            0
        ) AS delta_wait_ms

    FROM ordered_waits

    WHERE previous_wait_ms IS NOT NULL
),

categorized AS (
    SELECT
        CASE

            WHEN wait_type LIKE 'LCK_M_%'
                THEN 'قفل‌گذاری'

            WHEN wait_type IN (
                'PAGEIOLATCH_SH',
                'PAGEIOLATCH_EX',
                'PAGEIOLATCH_UP',
                'IO_COMPLETION',
                'ASYNC_IO_COMPLETION',
                'WRITELOG'
            )
                THEN 'ورودی/خروجی'

            WHEN wait_type IN (
                'SOS_SCHEDULER_YIELD',
                'THREADPOOL'
            )
                THEN 'پردازنده و Scheduler'

            WHEN wait_type IN (
                'RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE',
                'RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE_QUERY_COMPILE'
            )
                THEN 'حافظه'

            WHEN wait_type IN (
                'CXPACKET',
                'CXCONSUMER'
            )
                THEN 'پردازش موازی'

            WHEN wait_type = 'ASYNC_NETWORK_IO'
                THEN 'شبکه / کلاینت'

            ELSE NULL
        END AS category,

        delta_wait_ms

    FROM deltas
)

SELECT
    category AS "دسته انتظار",
    ROUND(SUM(delta_wait_ms)::numeric, 0) AS "زمان انتظار (ms)"

FROM categorized

WHERE category IS NOT NULL

GROUP BY category
HAVING SUM(delta_wait_ms) > 0

ORDER BY SUM(delta_wait_ms) DESC;
